from build123d import *

arm_length = 80.0
arm_width = 20.0
arm_thickness = 15.0
slot_width = 5.0
slot_length = 30.0
slot_offset = 10.0
hole_diameter = 5.0
hole_offset = 40.0
fillet_radius = 3.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (arm_width, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (arm_width, arm_length))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (arm_width - slot_width, arm_length))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (arm_width - slot_width, arm_length - slot_offset))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (arm_width - 2 * slot_width, arm_length - slot_offset))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (arm_width - 2 * slot_width, arm_length - slot_offset - slot_length))
            l7 = Line(l6 @ 1, (arm_width - slot_width, arm_length - slot_offset - slot_length))
            l8 = Line(l7 @ 1, (arm_width - slot_width, 0))
            l9 = Line(l8 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=arm_thickness)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(hole_offset, arm_length / 2, arm_thickness / 2) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, arm_thickness)
z_edges = solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
solid_body = fillet(z_edges, fillet_radius)

part = solid_body
part.name = "arm_with_slot_and_hole"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

outer_diameter = 30.0
wall_thickness = 0.6
length = 40.0
flange_thickness = 3.0
flange_outer_diameter = 80.0
pocket_width = 20.0
pocket_height = 10.0
pocket_depth = 2.0
chamfer_size = 0.5
hole_diameter = 5.0
hole_offset = 15.0

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius = outer_radius - wall_thickness
flange_outer_radius = flange_outer_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((inner_radius, 0), (outer_radius, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1@1, (outer_radius, length))
            l3 = Line(l2@1, (inner_radius, length))
            l4 = Line(l3@1, (inner_radius, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid_body = p.part

flange = Pos(0, 0, flange_thickness / 2) * Cylinder(flange_outer_radius, flange_thickness)
solid_body = solid_body + flange

pocket = Pos(0, 0, length - pocket_depth / 2) * Box(pocket_width, pocket_height, pocket_depth)
solid_body = solid_body - pocket

hole = Pos(hole_offset, 0, length / 2) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, length + 10)
solid_body = solid_body - hole

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
top_edges = top_face.edges()
solid_body = chamfer(top_edges, chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
part.name = "hollow_cylinder_with_flange"
export_step(part, "output.step")
